title: Codex plugin execution policy
description: Capability policy for write-capable Codex agents. Lives at .codex-plugin/policy.json in the repository root. When this file is absent or invalid the plugin denies every write capability and only read-only agents run. This schema documents the shape for editors; the plugin enforces it with hand-written validation in scripts/lib/policy.mjs.

version.description: Policy format version. An unrecognized version denies all write capability.

agents.description: Per-agent capability. Agents absent from this map cannot write.

writableGlobs.description: Repository-relative globs the agent may modify. Required for write agents. Supports *, ?, and **. Absolute paths and .. are rejected.

verification.description: Structured verification commands run inside the job worktree. argv arrays only: no shell string is ever evaluated.

required.description: Defaults to true. A failing required check blocks completion and landing.

envPassthrough.description: Environment variable names forwarded to spawned Codex processes. Everything else is stripped.

allowedCommands.description: argv prefixes Codex may run when the sandbox blocks a command. Matching is by exact prefix, so ["npm","test"] allows `npm test --silent` but not `npm publish`. Omitted or empty means no command approval is ever granted.

allowAutoLand.description: When false, a verified diff is never landed automatically regardless of the host permission mode.

requireCleanTree.description: When true, landing refuses if the target working tree has uncommitted changes.
